voice.welcome: Ready to chase some shadows? Pick a shadow game!
voice.choose-match: Find a shadow! Look closely, then tap the matching shape.
voice.choose-sun: Chase the sun! Slide the sun until your shadow matches the picture.
voice.choose-show: Make a shadow show! Move the sun, or press play to watch a whole day.
voice.match-rabbit: Which shadow belongs to the rabbit?
voice.match-squirrel: Which shadow belongs to the squirrel?
voice.match-turtle: Which shadow belongs to the turtle?
voice.match-fox: Which shadow belongs to the fox?
voice.match-duck: Which shadow belongs to the duck?
voice.match-bear: Which shadow belongs to the bear?
voice.look-closer: Look at the outside shape. You can find it!
voice.found: You found it! That shadow fits perfectly.
voice.sun-intro: Move the sun. Watch the shadow stretch, shrink, and switch sides!
voice.sun-nudge: Try sliding the big sun along its wooden track.
voice.sun-long: The sun is low, so the shadow stretches long!
voice.sun-short: The sun is high, so the shadow tucks in close!
voice.sun-opposite: You did it! The shadow points away from the sun.
voice.show-intro: Choose a toy for your shadow show.
voice.show-morning: Morning sun is low. The shadow stretches away.
voice.show-noon: At noon, the sun is high. The shadow tucks in close.
voice.show-evening: Evening sun is low on the other side. The shadow stretches back.
voice.show-complete: You made a whole day of shadows!
voice.all-done: Shadow star! You chased every shadow.
voice.idle: The shadows are waiting. Tap a toy or move the sun.

modes.title: Chase the Sun
modes.skill: light and shadow cause and effect
